read.en: Berkshire Hathaway B was flat on Nov 16 at $592.85, trading $588.55–595.83. It is above the 5-day ($589.4), 10-day ($580.2), 30-day ($547.8), 100-day ($517.3) and 200-day ($501.0), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 8, above zero, histogram easing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 30 ($573.38), and RSI is 80.8, overbought.
read.zh: 伯克希尔 B 股 11月16日持平，收于 $592.85，盘中区间 $588.55–595.83。股价位于 5 日（$589.4）、10 日（$580.2）、30 日（$547.8）、100 日（$517.3）和 200 日均线（$501.0）上方，均在上行。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看多（$573.38），RSI 为 80.8，处于超买。

read.en: No level changed: the $595.83 high stayed under the $596.92 52-week high (Nov 12), and the $588.55 low held above the Nov 11 close. Resistance is $595.8–596.9, then the round $600. Support is $588.2–589.4 (Nov 11 close, Nov 12 low, 5-day), then $579.1–580.2 (Nov 4 close, 10-day) and $570.9–573.4 (Nov 6 close, SAR). A close above $596.9 would target $600; below $588, $579–580.
